audit.whatIsWrong: Graded HARD, 8/10, red tone with all seven full-layer stages given to Yone, while the win rate is 53.47% over 303 games and the content layer gives Neeko all seven stages.
audit.why: Yone has no ranged poke and must stand at 450 to stack Mortal Steel, which is exactly where Tangle-Barbs and a double Blooming Burst live. The page graded the lane against its own data.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN, tone #e8b84b, diffRating 5/10, all seven full sides set to Neeko with matching whys. Carry threat left at 8.5/10.
sources: champ-data/mid/ahri.js for the EVEN/#e8b84b token pair

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one of Yone's cooldowns or ranges appeared anywhere on the page, including in breakdown.cooldowns.
audit.why: Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1 and 10s at rank 5 — that spread is the entire schedule of this lane. Mortal Steel is a flat 4s at 450 range, Spirit Cleave is 14s and shields more per champion hit, Fate Sealed is 120/100/80s at 1000.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, the phases, the do's, the don'ts and report[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[0] calls his E 'Spirit Unbound'; the page also never states that Spirit Cleave's shield scales with the number of champions hit.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon has E = Soul Unbound and W = Spirit Cleave, whose shield 'is increased by the number of champions hit'. Fighting him inside a clump feeds the shield that eats your burst.
audit.corrected: Name fixed; the shield scaling stated in breakdown.cooldowns and tradeBad.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Copy-paste bleed — 'Clone the disengage to split his chase' was explained by a generic step-up trade line.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to their own titles around Soul Unbound's cooldown and the post-root re-shield.

edits.after: The clone is a 16s cooldown at rank 1 and it is the only thing that splits his chase — do not spend it to win a farm trade.

edits.before: Q-poking with E banked 'for safety' until the lane forgets your kill threat exists — the root IS the threat; the bloom is just the receipt.
edits.after: After the root ends Mortal Steel is back in 4s and Spirit Cleave has re-shielded him — take the burst window and step out of 450.

edits.before: Track Yone’s Soul Unbound: His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Track Yone’s Soul Unbound: 22s at rank 1, 10s at rank 5. The body stays behind while the spirit is out — root the return, not the spirit.

notes: Graded HARD/8/10 against a 53.47% win rate with a content chart that gives Neeko every stage; set to EVEN/#e8b84b/5/10 and the full-layer chart matched to the content layer and packet.levelChart. The EVEN/#e8b84b token pair was confirmed from an existing entry rather than guessed. Left alone deliberately: content 'mid' says Soul Unbound leaves his body behind 'for 1.5-4s' — the kit gives no duration, so I could neither confirm nor replace it without inventing (listed in unverified). I also did not claim that Pop Blossom's stun interrupts Fate Sealed: it is a blink-and-slash, not a flagged channel, and nothing in the kit settles whether CC cancels it. breakdown.wave, breakdown.feeding and 'ahead' remain templated.
